name: tldr-write
notes: Appropriateness replaces safety as the third floor. Safety in the tldr suite guards destructive commands and security findings, which rarely appear in an email; the analogous thing a writing skill can trade away is the reader's goodwill. It sits at 20% for the same reason fidelity sits at 25% in the tldr suite: it is the dimension this skill could win on by cheating, so it is weighted until the cheat loses. never-cut and tone are the disqualifying categories for the same reason never-compress and safety are in the tldr suite - a blocker there is a message you would have to un-send.
